rationale: A physical grain dimension is not generally identical to a coherent crystallite-domain size inferred from X-ray diffraction.  References 47.
recommended_value: Characteristic dimension of a microstructural grain, determined using a stated grain-size metric and characterization method.
registry_final_value: A property denoting characteristic grain/crystallite size estimated from XRD using Scherrer formula (reported ~5 nm for β-SiC at 1600°C).
released_value: A property denoting characteristic grain/crystallite size estimated from XRD using Scherrer formula (reported ~5 nm for β-SiC at 1600°C).

current_value: A property denoting percent contribution of graphitic/aliphatic carbon component in C 1s XPS deconvolution.
implementation: Use the proposed definition only when graphitic carbon is resolved. For the combined component currently described, rename the class to describe the combined C–C/C–H signal fraction and use the alternative. Do not equate XPS peak-area percentage with bulk carbon mass fraction.
rationale: Graphitic carbon and a combined graphitic/aliphatic C–C/C–H component are not the same observable.
recommended_value: Percentage of the integrated C 1s X-ray photoelectron signal assigned to the graphitic sp²-carbon component under a stated peak-fitting model.
registry_final_value: A property denoting percent contribution of graphitic/aliphatic carbon component in C 1s XPS deconvolution.
released_value: A property denoting percent contribution of graphitic/aliphatic carbon component in C 1s XPS deconvolution.

current_value: A property denoting authors report anode 'ECSA' in units of mA·V·cm^-2 from H2 desorption peak integration; likely proportional to charge density (needs curation).
implementation: For constant scan rate v, divide this potential integral by v to obtain hydrogen charge per the current-density reference area. Obtaining active Pt area requires an additional reference monolayer charge per Pt area. State the electrode-area basis and integration bounds. If the process is adsorbed-hydrogen oxidation, prefer a label without H₂, which can suggest molecular hydrogen evolution or desorption.
rationale: The integral has current-density times potential units; it is neither charge density nor electrochemically active area by itself.
recommended_value: Potential integral of the baseline-corrected current density assigned to oxidative desorption of adsorbed hydrogen over a specified voltammetric peak, calculated as the integral of j(E) with respect to electrode potential E.
registry_final_value: Potential integral of the baseline-corrected current density assigned to oxidative desorption of adsorbed hydrogen over a specified voltammetric peak, calculated as the integral of j(E) with respect to electrode potential E.
released_value: Potential integral of the baseline-corrected current density assigned to oxidative desorption of adsorbed hydrogen over a specified voltammetric peak, calculated as the integral of j(E) with respect to electrode potential E.

current_value: A property denoting half wave potential shift relative to nafion and determined in Accelerated Stress Test Voltage Cycling.
implementation: Use the stated positive-for-test-higher convention only if consistent with source values; otherwise preserve the source convention explicitly. Match potential scale, electrolyte, loading and hydrodynamic conditions.
rationale: The comparison needs a reference electrode formulation and sign convention; it is not inherently an accelerated-stress-test result.
recommended_value: Difference between the oxygen-reduction half-wave potential of the investigated electrode and that of a matched electrode using Nafion ionomer, calculated as E₁/₂,test minus E₁/₂,Nafion.
registry_final_value: A property denoting half wave potential shift relative to nafion and determined in Accelerated Stress Test Voltage Cycling.
released_value: A property denoting half wave potential shift relative to nafion and determined in Accelerated Stress Test Voltage Cycling.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents henrys coefficient for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Adopt only if source units and equation identify c/p. If p/c is used, select the alternative; other conventions require their corresponding explicit definition. Record gas, solvent or ionomer, temperature and pressure range.
rationale: Henry coefficients have several reciprocal or differently normalized conventions.  References 23.
recommended_value: Henry solubility coefficient on an amount-concentration/partial-pressure basis, defined in the infinite-dilution limit as equilibrium dissolved-gas amount concentration divided by gas partial pressure.
registry_final_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents henrys coefficient for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents henrys coefficient for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A property denoting ohmic/HFR concept in RQ (discussed conceptually).
implementation: Specify whether the value is resistance in ohms or area-specific resistance in ohm area. Record intercept-estimation method; an arbitrary high-frequency real component need not equal the true intercept.
rationale: The existing text is a research-question note rather than a resistance definition.
recommended_value: Ohmic resistance estimated from the high-frequency real-axis intercept of an electrochemical impedance spectrum of the specified cell or electrode assembly.
registry_final_value: Ohmic resistance estimated from the high-frequency real-axis intercept of an electrochemical impedance spectrum of the specified cell or electrode assembly.
released_value: Ohmic resistance estimated from the high-frequency real-axis intercept of an electrochemical impedance spectrum of the specified cell or electrode assembly.

current_value: A property denoting hydration number lambda and determined in Membrane Swelling Measurement.
implementation: For sulfonated ionomers, identify whether sites are counted as sulfonic-acid or sulfonate groups and state conditioning. The definition does not impose a particular measurement technique.
rationale: The observable is the water-to-site amount ratio rather than a swelling measurement itself.
recommended_value: Average number of water molecules per specified ion-exchange site in an ionomer, calculated as the amount of water divided by the amount of ion-exchange sites.
registry_final_value: Average number of water molecules per specified ion-exchange site in an ionomer, calculated as the amount of water divided by the amount of ion-exchange sites.
released_value: Average number of water molecules per specified ion-exchange site in an ionomer, calculated as the amount of water divided by the amount of ion-exchange sites.

current_value: An electrochemical characteristic that represents hydrogen oxidation charge constant for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Record the numerical reference value, Pt surface assumption, electrolyte and convention used for active-area conversion; do not impose a universal constant.
rationale: The source context describes a surface-specific reference charge, not a universal total charge.
recommended_value: Reference electric charge per unit true platinum surface area for oxidation of an adsorbed hydrogen monolayer under a specified electrochemical protocol.
registry_final_value: Reference electric charge per unit true platinum surface area for oxidation of an adsorbed hydrogen monolayer under a specified electrochemical protocol.
released_value: Reference electric charge per unit true platinum surface area for oxidation of an adsorbed hydrogen monolayer under a specified electrochemical protocol.

current_value: A property denoting hydrolysis rate through membrane during conversion of sulfonyl fluoride to sulfonic acid groups.
implementation: Use the proposed definition when the source reports conversion/time. If it reports penetration distance/time, rename the characteristic to hydrolysis-front propagation speed and use the alternative. Specify whether acid or salt form is measured.
rationale: Chemical conversion rate and motion of a reaction front have different dimensions and should not share one definition.
recommended_value: Rate of conversion of sulfonyl-fluoride groups in a membrane into sulfonic-acid or sulfonate groups, expressed as change in the specified extent of conversion per unit time.
registry_final_value: A property denoting hydrolysis rate through membrane during conversion of sulfonyl fluoride to sulfonic acid groups.
released_value: A property denoting hydrolysis rate through membrane during conversion of sulfonyl fluoride to sulfonic acid groups.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents hydrolysis rate slowdown factor for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Confirm the source defines slowdown as the high-temperature rate divided by the low-temperature rate; invert the definition if its reported factor uses the reciprocal. Specify whether the rates are conversion rates, fitted constants, or front speeds.
rationale: The original omits the orientation of the rate ratio.
recommended_value: Ratio of the hydrolysis rate at 75 °C to the hydrolysis rate at 25 °C for the same conversion observable and otherwise matched conditions.
registry_final_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents hydrolysis rate slowdown factor for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents hydrolysis rate slowdown factor for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A property denoting impedance modulus slope K and determined in Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Potentiostatic.
implementation: Retrieve the source figure or equation defining K. Identify whether it is d|Z|/df, dlog|Z|/dlogf, slope versus another frequency function, or a fitted circuit coefficient; record frequency interval, sign, log convention and units. Do not define K as a generic electrical resistance.
rationale: The physical slope cannot be identified without the independent variable and transformation of the impedance-modulus plot.
registry_final_value: A property denoting impedance modulus slope K and determined in Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Potentiostatic.
released_value: A property denoting impedance modulus slope K and determined in Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Potentiostatic.

current_value: A property denoting initial catalytic activity loss percent and determined in Review Statement Extraction.
implementation: State the catalytic activity measure, initial state, comparison state and matched measurement conditions. A negative value denotes an activity gain under this convention.
rationale: A percentage loss requires a baseline and sign convention; review-statement extraction is not the physical observable.
recommended_value: Percentage decrease in a specified catalytic activity from an identified initial reference state to an identified comparison state, calculated as 100 times the initial activity minus the comparison activity, divided by the initial activity.
registry_final_value: Percentage decrease in a specified catalytic activity from an identified initial reference state to an identified comparison state, calculated as 100 times the initial activity minus the comparison activity, divided by the initial activity.
released_value: Percentage decrease in a specified catalytic activity from an identified initial reference state to an identified comparison state, calculated as 100 times the initial activity minus the comparison activity, divided by the initial activity.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents initial membrane water content lambda for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: State the initial event, ionic-site identity and conditioning; for cold start, identify whether initial content excludes surface or channel water.
rationale: Lambda denotes water molecules per ionic site, not an unspecified water-content measure.
recommended_value: Initial membrane hydration number before the specified operation, equal to the amount of membrane water divided by the amount of membrane ion-exchange sites.
registry_final_value: Initial membrane hydration number before the specified operation, equal to the amount of membrane water divided by the amount of membrane ion-exchange sites.
released_value: Initial membrane hydration number before the specified operation, equal to the amount of membrane water divided by the amount of membrane ion-exchange sites.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents ink dilution ratio for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Use only after confirming final/initial convention. Otherwise use the alternative. Record added volumes and avoid assuming strict volume additivity when precision requires it.
rationale: Dilution ratio may mean final/initial volume or added-diluent/initial volume; those differ by one when volumes are additive.
recommended_value: Ratio of final diluted-ink suspension volume to the initial ink aliquot volume used for dilution.
registry_final_value: A composition characteristic that represents ink dilution ratio for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A composition characteristic that represents ink dilution ratio for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents inkjet printing spatial resolution for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: State the feature metric and reproducibility criterion. If existing source data describe droplet placement error, assign them to a separate placement-accuracy characteristic.
rationale: Feature resolution and positional placement accuracy are different observables.
recommended_value: Minimum feature dimension or separation that an inkjet-printing process can reproducibly distinguish in a printed pattern under specified printing and substrate conditions.
registry_final_value: Minimum feature dimension or separation that an inkjet-printing process can reproducibly distinguish in a printed pattern under specified printing and substrate conditions.
released_value: Minimum feature dimension or separation that an inkjet-printing process can reproducibly distinguish in a printed pattern under specified printing and substrate conditions.

current_value: A property denoting ink storage stability duration and determined in Review Statement Extraction.
implementation: Record the failure or censoring criterion, such as phase-separation threshold, particle-size change, or rheological change. Distinguish “stable for at least t” from a measured failure time.
rationale: A stability duration requires an explicit criterion rather than an extraction activity.
recommended_value: Elapsed storage time for which an ink satisfies a specified stability criterion under stated storage conditions.
registry_final_value: Elapsed storage time for which an ink satisfies a specified stability criterion under stated storage conditions.
released_value: Elapsed storage time for which an ink satisfies a specified stability criterion under stated storage conditions.

current_value: A property denoting interfacial resistance.
implementation: Use this definition only after confirming the source convention and rename to “gas–ionomer interfacial oxygen transport resistance”; use TransportCharacteristic or SurfaceCharacteristic as parent then. If the source describes electrical resistance, use the alternative and retain ElectrochemicalCharacteristic.
rationale: The source aliases indicate gas-dissolution transport, while the existing name and definition could also mean electrical interfacial resistance.
recommended_value: Oxygen mass-transfer resistance associated with crossing a specified gas–ionomer interface, defined as the oxygen concentration drop across that interface divided by the oxygen molar flux on a stated reference-area basis.
registry_final_value: A property denoting interfacial resistance.
released_value: A property denoting interfacial resistance.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents intrinsic viscosity for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Prefer the label “suspension intrinsic-viscosity coefficient”. State the shear regime and the fitted Krieger–Dougherty equation; do not reuse polymer intrinsic-viscosity units.
rationale: The contextual Krieger–Dougherty parameter is a volume-fraction-based dimensionless coefficient, unlike polymer-solution intrinsic viscosity expressed per mass concentration.
recommended_value: Dimensionless dilute-suspension viscosity coefficient equal to the limit of (ηᵣ − 1)/φ as particle volume fraction φ approaches zero, where ηᵣ is suspension viscosity divided by continuous-phase viscosity.
registry_final_value: Dimensionless dilute-suspension viscosity coefficient equal to the limit of (ηᵣ − 1)/φ as particle volume fraction φ approaches zero, where ηᵣ is suspension viscosity divided by continuous-phase viscosity.
released_value: A rheological characteristic equal to the limiting value of reduced viscosity or inherent viscosity of a polymer solution as solute concentration approaches zero.

current_value: A performance characteristic that represents ion exchange capacity for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: State acid/salt form, drying method, measurement method and whether measured or theoretical IEC is reported. One milliequivalent per gram equals one millimole of monovalent exchangeable charge per gram.
rationale: The definition needs the charge-equivalent numerator and dry-material basis.
recommended_value: Amount of exchangeable ionic charge in an ion-exchange material divided by its dry mass, expressed as charge equivalents per unit mass.
registry_final_value: Amount of exchangeable ionic charge in an ion-exchange material divided by its dry mass, expressed as charge equivalents per unit mass.
released_value: Amount of exchangeable ionic charge in an ion-exchange material divided by its dry mass, expressed as charge equivalents per unit mass.

current_value: A mechanical characteristic that represents ionic strength for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: This definition adopts amount concentration. If a molality basis is required, create or clearly distinguish Iₘ = ½ Σᵢ mᵢ zᵢ². Do not treat a salt-free formulation as ion-free when acid or ionomer counterions are present.
rationale: All dissolved ions contribute; ionic strength is not generally equal to hydrogen-ion concentration.  References 16.
recommended_value: One half of the sum, over all dissolved ionic species, of each species' amount concentration multiplied by the square of its charge number.
registry_final_value: One half of the sum, over all dissolved ionic species, of each species' amount concentration multiplied by the square of its charge number.
released_value: One half of the sum, over all dissolved ionic species, of each species' amount concentration multiplied by the square of its charge number.

current_value: A property denoting ionomer connected electrochemically active surface area and determined in Carbon Monoxide Stripping Voltammetry.
implementation: State the selective protocol, humidity and liquid-water conditions, Pt reference charge and normalization. If the source measures total accessible ECSA without selectivity, assign it to total ECSA instead.
rationale: Ordinary CO stripping alone does not prove selective measurement of ionomer-connected Pt area.
recommended_value: Electrochemically active platinum surface area supplied with protons through connected ionomer pathways under a protocol designed to distinguish that contribution from sites supplied through liquid-water pathways.
registry_final_value: A property denoting ionomer connected electrochemically active surface area and determined in Carbon Monoxide Stripping Voltammetry.
released_value: A property denoting ionomer connected electrochemically active surface area and determined in Carbon Monoxide Stripping Voltammetry.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents ionomer equivalent weight for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: State the ionomer form and ionic-site type. For monovalent sites, one equivalent corresponds to one mole of sites; record the usual g eq⁻¹ basis.
rationale: Equivalent weight requires a mass-per-charge-equivalent identity.
recommended_value: Dry ionomer mass per equivalent of exchangeable ionic charge.
registry_final_value: Dry ionomer mass per equivalent of exchangeable ionic charge.
released_value: Dry ionomer mass per equivalent of exchangeable ionic charge.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents ionomer mass fraction for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Record whether the reference domain is dry catalyst-layer solids, all ink constituents, or another declared domain. Do not impose a dry-solids basis on ink-mixture data; remove ratio aliases that imply a different denominator.
rationale: A mass fraction is a constituent/total ratio, not an ionomer-to-catalyst ratio.  References 15.
recommended_value: Mass of ionomer divided by the total mass of the explicitly specified mixture or material reference domain.
registry_final_value: Mass of ionomer divided by the total mass of the explicitly specified mixture or material reference domain.
released_value: Mass of ionomer divided by the total mass of the explicitly specified mixture or material reference domain.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents ionomer to catalyst mass ratio for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Declare whether the catalyst denominator includes support and any binder. Use separate specializations or normalization metadata for supported-catalyst and metal-only ratios.
rationale: Catalyst may mean supported catalyst or active metal; these denominators are not interchangeable.
recommended_value: Ratio of dry ionomer mass to the mass of the explicitly identified catalyst material in the same formulation or electrode.
registry_final_value: Ratio of dry ionomer mass to the mass of the explicitly identified catalyst material in the same formulation or electrode.
released_value: Ratio of dry ionomer mass to the mass of the explicitly identified catalyst material in the same formulation or electrode.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents ionomer uniformity for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Before using existing numbers, identify the actual statistic, field being sampled and spatial region. If the source only states “uniform ionomer distribution”, represent that assertion as a qualitative descriptor instead of inventing a numerical score.
rationale: No single conventional numerical uniformity index is implied by the current class name.
recommended_value: Quantitative measure of spatial uniformity of ionomer distribution over a defined material region, determined using a specified observable, sampling scale and mathematical statistic.
registry_final_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents ionomer uniformity for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents ionomer uniformity for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents ircompensation fraction for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: State the resistance-estimation method, correction procedure and whether the fraction is expressed on a 0–1 or 0–100 percent scale.
rationale: The corrected quantity is an ohmic potential drop, not a composition fraction.
recommended_value: Fraction of the estimated uncompensated ohmic voltage drop iR that is corrected by an electrochemical instrument or by post-processing.
registry_final_value: Fraction of the estimated uncompensated ohmic voltage drop iR that is corrected by an electrochemical instrument or by post-processing.
released_value: Fraction of the estimated uncompensated ohmic voltage drop iR that is corrected by an electrochemical instrument or by post-processing.

current_value: A property denoting kinetic current normalized to Geometric Area and determined in Rotating Ring Disk Voltammetry and Linear Sweep Voltammetry.
implementation: To preserve the geometric-area-normalized source data, rename the existing class to KineticCurrentDensity and use the alternative. Otherwise retain KineticCurrent for amperes and migrate area-normalized records.
rationale: Current divided by geometric electrode area is kinetic current density, not current.
recommended_value: Mass-transport-corrected faradaic current representing the electrode reaction rate at a specified potential under the stated kinetic-current model.
registry_final_value: A property denoting kinetic current normalized to Geometric Area and determined in Rotating Ring Disk Voltammetry and Linear Sweep Voltammetry.
released_value: A property denoting kinetic current normalized to Geometric Area and determined in Rotating Ring Disk Voltammetry and Linear Sweep Voltammetry.

current_value: A count characteristic that represents knudsen number for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: State the gas, temperature, pressure and characteristic-length convention; pore diameter and radius give different numeric Knudsen numbers.
rationale: The quantity is a ratio of lengths rather than a count.
recommended_value: The dimensionless ratio of molecular mean free path to the stated characteristic transport length, such as a pore diameter.
registry_final_value: The dimensionless ratio of molecular mean free path to the stated characteristic transport length, such as a pore diameter.
released_value: The dimensionless ratio of molecular mean free path to the stated characteristic transport length, such as a pore diameter.

current_value: A property denoting large pore fraction above 150 nm and determined in FIBSEM Tomography Measurement.
implementation: Record the pore-size metric, segmentation method, analyzed region and weighting. Do not compare count fractions directly with pore-volume fractions.
rationale: The threshold alone does not determine the fraction’s denominator or weighting.
recommended_value: Fraction of a specified pore population having a stated pore-size metric greater than 150 nm, calculated using an explicitly declared count, area or pore-volume weighting.
registry_final_value: A property denoting large pore fraction above 150 nm and determined in FIBSEM Tomography Measurement.
released_value: A property denoting large pore fraction above 150 nm and determined in FIBSEM Tomography Measurement.

current_value: A geometric characteristic that represents laser pulse length for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Prefer label “laser pulse duration”; specify full width at half maximum, 1/e width, or the source’s duration convention.
rationale: The source describes nanosecond duration, rather than spatial pulse length.
recommended_value: Temporal duration of a laser pulse, measured using a stated criterion on its time-dependent intensity profile.
registry_final_value: Temporal duration of a laser pulse, measured using a stated criterion on its time-dependent intensity profile.
released_value: Temporal duration of a laser pulse, measured using a stated criterion on its time-dependent intensity profile.

current_value: A property denoting lattice distortion percent.
implementation: Adopt only if the source reports a relative lattice-parameter change. If it reports root-mean-square microstrain or another distortion invariant, retrieve its equation and use that specific identity. State signed versus absolute convention.
rationale: A lattice-parameter change and a distribution-based microstrain metric are distinct quantities.
recommended_value: Percentage change in a specified lattice parameter relative to a declared reference, calculated as 100 times the measured parameter minus the reference parameter, divided by the reference parameter.
registry_final_value: A property denoting lattice distortion percent.
released_value: A property denoting lattice distortion percent.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents li cl to bi molar ratio for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Write the ratio as n(LiCl)/n(benzimidazole repeat units); identify the polymer and counting convention for its benzimidazole units.
rationale: The description identifies BI as benzimidazole units, not elemental bismuth.
recommended_value: Amount ratio of lithium chloride to benzimidazole repeat units in the specified solution or formulation.
registry_final_value: Amount ratio of lithium chloride to benzimidazole repeat units in the specified solution or formulation.
released_value: Amount ratio of lithium chloride to benzimidazole repeat units in the specified solution or formulation.

current_value: A property denoting local gas transport resistance normalized to Geometric Area and determined in Oxygen Gain/Loss Measurement and Limiting Current Measurement.
implementation: Identify the transported gas, region and separation method. Keep concentration-normalized and pressure-normalized resistance distinct, and record geometric or catalyst-area normalization.
rationale: A local resistance requires both a physical region and a driving-force/flux convention.
recommended_value: Contribution to gas mass-transfer resistance assigned to a specified local catalyst region or interface, defined using a declared gas concentration or partial-pressure driving force divided by molar flux on a stated area basis.
registry_final_value: A property denoting local gas transport resistance normalized to Geometric Area and determined in Oxygen Gain/Loss Measurement and Limiting Current Measurement.
released_value: A property denoting local gas transport resistance normalized to Geometric Area and determined in Oxygen Gain/Loss Measurement and Limiting Current Measurement.

current_value: A property denoting local oxygen transport resistance normalized to Geometric Area and determined in Oxygen Gain/Loss Measurement, O2–N2 Switching Measurement, and Through-Plane Gas Transport Measurement.
implementation: State whether the value is normalized to geometric area or Pt area, how local resistance is separated, and which ionomer-film or interfacial contributions are included. Do not equate it with all Knudsen or pressure-independent contributions.
rationale: Local catalyst-region resistance is not automatically identical to the entire pressure-independent resistance.
recommended_value: Oxygen mass-transfer resistance associated with the immediate environment of catalyst reaction sites, determined using a stated oxygen driving-force and flux convention and a declared reference area.
registry_final_value: A property denoting local oxygen transport resistance normalized to Geometric Area and determined in Oxygen Gain/Loss Measurement, O2–N2 Switching Measurement, and Through-Plane Gas Transport Measurement.
released_value: A property denoting local oxygen transport resistance normalized to Geometric Area and determined in Oxygen Gain/Loss Measurement, O2–N2 Switching Measurement, and Through-Plane Gas Transport Measurement.

current_value: A statistical characteristic that represents log normal standard deviation for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Adopt after checking the source uses natural-log width σ; geometric standard deviation is exp(σ). If the paper uses log base 10 or reports geometric standard deviation, state that convention instead.
rationale: The standard deviation of log diameter differs from geometric standard deviation and ordinary diameter standard deviation.
recommended_value: Standard deviation of the natural logarithm of particle diameter divided by a fixed reference diameter, for a lognormally distributed diameter variable.
registry_final_value: A statistical characteristic that represents log normal standard deviation for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A statistical characteristic that represents log normal standard deviation for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A mechanical characteristic that represents magnetic field strength for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: If existing source values are in tesla, rename the characteristic to magnetic flux density and use the alternative; do not change numeric units without the appropriate relation and medium information.
rationale: H and magnetic flux density B are distinct quantities despite frequently sharing the informal name magnetic field.
recommended_value: Magnitude of the magnetic field strength H at the specified location, expressed in amperes per metre.
registry_final_value: A mechanical characteristic that represents magnetic field strength for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A mechanical characteristic that represents magnetic field strength for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents manufacturing throughput increase factor for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Specify output metric, such as coated area or accepted product count per time, and the reference process. Under this convention a factor of two means twice the baseline throughput.
rationale: A throughput ratio differs from a fractional or percentage increase.
recommended_value: Ratio of manufacturing throughput for the investigated process to throughput for a declared reference process, calculated using the same output measure and time basis.
registry_final_value: Ratio of manufacturing throughput for the investigated process to throughput for a declared reference process, calculated using the same output measure and time basis.
released_value: Ratio of manufacturing throughput for the investigated process to throughput for a declared reference process, calculated using the same output measure and time basis.

current_value: A property denoting mass activity and determined in MEAPolarization, Rotating Ring Disk Voltammetry, and Linear Sweep Voltammetry.
implementation: Record Pt, PGM, total-metal, supported-catalyst or other denominator; state whether the numerator is kinetic or measured current and whether current magnitude is used.
rationale: The mass denominator is essential for comparison of catalytic performance.
recommended_value: Electrochemical reaction current divided by the mass of the explicitly specified catalyst or active-metal reference material, measured at a stated potential and conditions.
registry_final_value: Electrochemical reaction current divided by the mass of the explicitly specified catalyst or active-metal reference material, measured at a stated potential and conditions.
released_value: Electrochemical reaction current divided by the mass of the explicitly specified catalyst or active-metal reference material, measured at a stated potential and conditions.

current_value: A property denoting mass fractal dimension from low-q USAXS power-law scaling; higher indicates greater agglomeration.
implementation: For scattering-derived values, state the fitted q range and distinguish the mass-fractal regime from surface-fractal or Porod regimes.
rationale: A higher mass-fractal dimension indicates greater aggregate compactness within that model, rather than universally a larger degree of agglomeration.  References 24, 48.
recommended_value: The exponent relating aggregate mass to characteristic size through a power law over a specified scale range, estimated using a stated structural or scattering model.
registry_final_value: The exponent relating aggregate mass to characteristic size through a power law over a specified scale range, estimated using a stated structural or scattering model.
released_value: The exponent relating aggregate mass to characteristic size through a power law over a specified scale range, estimated using a stated structural or scattering model.

current_value: A property denoting mass transport resistance increase due to local percent.
implementation: Adopt only if the source defines an attributable share. Identify both states and common resistance normalization; the ratio is undefined when ΔR_total is zero. Use the alternative for local-resistance relative increase.
rationale: The source alias indicates a contribution share; that differs from percent growth of local resistance relative to its own baseline.
recommended_value: The percentage of a specified increase in total mass-transfer resistance attributable to the change in local resistance, equal to 100 times the local-resistance change divided by the total-resistance change.
registry_final_value: A property denoting mass transport resistance increase due to local percent.
released_value: A property denoting mass transport resistance increase due to local percent.

current_value: A property denoting mass transport resistance increase percent.
implementation: Use the same gas, driving-force convention, area basis and conditions for both resistances; identify the comparison states.
rationale: The reference state and denominator were absent.
recommended_value: The percentage increase in mass-transfer resistance relative to an identified reference state, equal to 100 times the difference between test and reference resistance divided by the reference resistance.
registry_final_value: The percentage increase in mass-transfer resistance relative to an identified reference state, equal to 100 times the difference between test and reference resistance divided by the reference resistance.
released_value: The percentage increase in mass-transfer resistance relative to an identified reference state, equal to 100 times the difference between test and reference resistance divided by the reference resistance.

current_value: A property denoting maximum N2 adsorption volume (proxy for pore volume).
implementation: State measurement temperature, maximum relative pressure, gas reference temperature/pressure and sample normalization. If source data are condensed-liquid-equivalent pore volumes, define and label that quantity separately.
rationale: Gas-equivalent uptake and liquid-equivalent pore volume are different observables.
recommended_value: Maximum measured nitrogen uptake in a specified adsorption experiment, expressed as an equivalent gas volume at stated reference conditions per declared sample amount.
registry_final_value: A property denoting maximum N2 adsorption volume (proxy for pore volume).
released_value: A property denoting maximum N2 adsorption volume (proxy for pore volume).

current_value: A property denoting max adsorption volume water.
implementation: Use only after confirming liquid-equivalent convention and conversion density. Record temperature and maximum water activity; if the source uses vapour-equivalent volume, use the alternative.
rationale: The existing term does not identify whether the quoted volume is liquid equivalent or vapour equivalent.
recommended_value: Maximum measured water uptake in a specified adsorption experiment, expressed as an equivalent liquid-water volume per declared sample amount at stated conditions.
registry_final_value: A property denoting max adsorption volume water.
released_value: A property denoting max adsorption volume water.

current_value: A geometric characteristic that represents maximum particle volume fraction for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: State the Krieger–Dougherty equation, fitting shear regime and phase-volume basis; distinguish model extrapolation from directly measured maximum packing.
rationale: The contextual parameter is a fitted limiting-packing parameter rather than an unspecified geometric maximum.
recommended_value: The maximum-packing particle volume-fraction parameter in a specified suspension-viscosity model, representing the model's limiting packing fraction at which the predicted viscosity diverges.
registry_final_value: The maximum-packing particle volume-fraction parameter in a specified suspension-viscosity model, representing the model's limiting packing fraction at which the predicted viscosity diverges.
released_value: The maximum-packing particle volume-fraction parameter in a specified suspension-viscosity model, representing the model's limiting packing fraction at which the predicted viscosity diverges.

current_value: A property denoting mean flow pore diameter and determined in Mercury Intrusion Porosimetry Measurement.
implementation: Replace the stated measurement association with capillary flow porometry if source evidence supports it. If the original method really was mercury intrusion, preserve the source data under a separately defined intrusion-distribution pore-diameter metric. State wetting liquid, contact angle and pore model.
rationale: Mean-flow pore size is an operational capillary-flow-porometry quantity, not simply a mercury-intrusion mean diameter.  References 32.
recommended_value: Equivalent through-pore diameter calculated from the capillary-flow pressure at which the wetted-sample gas-flow curve intersects one half of the dry-sample gas-flow curve.
registry_final_value: A property denoting mean flow pore diameter and determined in Mercury Intrusion Porosimetry Measurement.
released_value: A property denoting mean flow pore diameter and determined in Mercury Intrusion Porosimetry Measurement.

current_value: A property denoting pore volume attributed to mesopores (>2 nm in cited convention); reported/compared in cm^3/g.
implementation: Keep the method and mass basis explicit. If the source truly reports all pores wider than 2 nm, retain that value under a separate “pore volume above 2 nm” characteristic rather than relabeling it mesopore volume.
rationale: A lower threshold of 2 nm alone includes macropores as well as mesopores.  References 19.
recommended_value: Volume of pores with widths approximately 2–50 nm, per unit sample mass when reported as specific pore volume, determined using a stated pore-size analysis method.
registry_final_value: Volume of pores with widths approximately 2–50 nm, per unit sample mass when reported as specific pore volume, determined using a stated pore-size analysis method.
released_value: Volume of pores with widths approximately 2–50 nm, per unit sample mass when reported as specific pore volume, determined using a stated pore-size analysis method.

current_value: A property denoting upper bound of reported µm-scale pore size tunability range (10–20 µm).
implementation: To preserve the represented data, rename the class to MicrometreScalePoreSizeMax or an appropriate macropore-range-upper-bound label. Do not change the numbers to nanometres. If retaining the MicroporeSizeMax identity, move the existing data and use a definition restricted to pores not exceeding approximately 2 nm.
rationale: The recorded 10–20 µm range concerns macropores, not micropores in adsorption terminology.  References 20.
recommended_value: Upper bound of the micrometre-scale pore-size range in the specified material, determined using a stated pore-size metric and characterization method.
registry_final_value: A property denoting upper bound of reported µm-scale pore size tunability range (10–20 µm).
released_value: A property denoting upper bound of reported µm-scale pore size tunability range (10–20 µm).

current_value: A property denoting lower bound of reported µm-scale pore size tunability range (10–20 µm).
implementation: To preserve the represented data, rename the class to MicrometreScalePoreSizeMin or an appropriate macropore-range-lower-bound label. Do not change the numbers to nanometres. If retaining the MicroporeSizeMin identity, move the existing data and use a definition restricted to pores not exceeding approximately 2 nm.
rationale: The recorded 10–20 µm range concerns macropores, not micropores in adsorption terminology.  References 20.
recommended_value: Lower bound of the micrometre-scale pore-size range in the specified material, determined using a stated pore-size metric and characterization method.
registry_final_value: A property denoting lower bound of reported µm-scale pore size tunability range (10–20 µm).
released_value: A property denoting lower bound of reported µm-scale pore size tunability range (10–20 µm).

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents msa mass for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Identify MSA by full chemical name and a chemical identifier before final implementation. If MSA is delivered as a solution, distinguish mass of ligand solute from mass of solution; do not infer mercaptosuccinic acid or another species solely from the acronym.
rationale: The batch mass observable is recoverable, but the chemical expansion of MSA is not established by the supplied record.
recommended_value: Mass of the ligand identified as MSA added to a specified ligand-exchange batch.
registry_final_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents msa mass for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents msa mass for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents msa weight percent of qd powder for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Expand MSA to a verified chemical name and identify whether the powder includes pre-existing ligands. Prefer “MSA-to-quantum-dot-powder mass ratio (%)” to avoid implying a final-mixture mass fraction.
rationale: The recorded basis is initial quantum-dot powder mass, not total final formulation mass.
recommended_value: Percentage mass ratio of added MSA ligand to the initial quantum-dot powder, calculated as 100 times the ligand mass divided by the initial powder mass.
registry_final_value: A composition characteristic that represents msa weight percent of qd powder for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A composition characteristic that represents msa weight percent of qd powder for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents nafion fiber loading for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: State dry-mass determination, coated area and whether both membrane faces are included.
rationale: The source context identifies areal mass loading rather than a mass fraction.
recommended_value: Mass of dry Nafion fibers deposited on a membrane divided by the geometric area of the coated membrane region.
registry_final_value: Mass of dry Nafion fibers deposited on a membrane divided by the geometric area of the coated membrane region.
released_value: Mass of dry Nafion fibers deposited on a membrane divided by the geometric area of the coated membrane region.

current_value: A property denoting atomic percent (at.%) ratio of nitrogen to carbon measured by EDX in CNT forests.
implementation: Use the proposed definition only if source “N/C (at.%)” means 100 n_N/n_C; rename to “nitrogen-to-carbon atomic ratio (%)”. If the source instead means nitrogen atomic percentage, use the alternative. Identify EDX quantification basis and elements included.
rationale: An N/C ratio and nitrogen atomic percent among all elements have different denominators.
recommended_value: Nitrogen-to-carbon atomic ratio expressed as a percentage, calculated as 100 times the amount of nitrogen atoms divided by the amount of carbon atoms in the analyzed region.
registry_final_value: A property denoting atomic percent (at.%) ratio of nitrogen to carbon measured by EDX in CNT forests.
released_value: A property denoting atomic percent (at.%) ratio of nitrogen to carbon measured by EDX in CNT forests.

current_value: A property denoting non pt catalyst volumetric activity and determined in Review Statement Extraction.
implementation: Specify whether the denominator is catalyst-solid, catalyst-layer, or another volume and whether current is kinetic or measured. If source activity is a chemical reaction rate rather than current, define a separate rate-based specialization.
rationale: Volumetric activity needs both a reaction-rate numerator and a declared volume denominator.
recommended_value: Electrochemical reaction current generated by a non-platinum catalyst divided by the explicitly specified catalyst or catalyst-layer reference volume at stated potential and conditions.
registry_final_value: A property denoting non pt catalyst volumetric activity and determined in Review Statement Extraction.
released_value: A property denoting non pt catalyst volumetric activity and determined in Review Statement Extraction.

current_value: A property denoting other fatty acids mass fraction and determined in Gas Chromatography Measurement.
implementation: Adopt only if the analysis uses total fatty-acid mass. List the principal species excluded from “other”; if the source denominator is whole-sample mass, use the alternative. Do not assume chromatographic area percent equals mass percent without a justified response convention.
rationale: The residual category requires both its excluded species and its mass denominator.
recommended_value: Combined mass of fatty acids outside an explicitly enumerated principal-fatty-acid set divided by the total fatty-acid mass in the analyzed sample.
registry_final_value: A property denoting other fatty acids mass fraction and determined in Gas Chromatography Measurement.
released_value: A property denoting other fatty acids mass fraction and determined in Gas Chromatography Measurement.

current_value: A property denoting oxirane content and determined in Epoxy Equivalent Titration Measurement.
implementation: Use only if the source reports oxirane oxygen content. For a titration reported as epoxide equivalents per mass, use the alternative and a corresponding label. Record titration conversion and reporting basis; do not infer basis from the method name alone.
rationale: Oxirane-oxygen mass fraction, epoxide equivalents per mass and epoxy equivalent weight are related but different quantities.
recommended_value: Mass fraction of oxygen atoms present in oxirane rings in the specified material.
registry_final_value: A property denoting oxirane content and determined in Epoxy Equivalent Titration Measurement.
released_value: A property denoting oxirane content and determined in Epoxy Equivalent Titration Measurement.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents oxygen solubility in ionomer for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Adopt when the source reports dissolved oxygen concentration. For c/p-type data, use a separately identified Henry solubility coefficient and the alternative. State dry, swollen or other volume basis.
rationale: An equilibrium dissolved concentration differs from a pressure-normalized solubility coefficient.  References 23.
recommended_value: Equilibrium amount concentration of molecular oxygen dissolved in a specified ionomer at stated temperature, oxygen partial pressure and ionomer hydration state.
registry_final_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents oxygen solubility in ionomer for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents oxygen solubility in ionomer for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents palladium chloride concentration ppm for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Use only if the source reports mass-based PdCl₂ ppm; verify hydrate or anhydrous form. For Pd-equivalent mass concentration, relabel and use the alternative. A stated mg L⁻¹ value is not automatically ppm without an explicit density or convention.
rationale: The reporting basis of ppm and whether it refers to compound mass or elemental palladium must be distinguished.
recommended_value: Mass fraction of palladium chloride in the specified mixture expressed in parts per million, equal to one million times the mass of palladium chloride divided by total mixture mass.
registry_final_value: A composition characteristic that represents palladium chloride concentration ppm for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A composition characteristic that represents palladium chloride concentration ppm for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A property denoting 10th percentile of particle size distribution from DLS (D10).
implementation: For DLS, specify hydrodynamic diameter, intensity/volume/number weighting and inversion or conversion method. The class can remain generic if every value carries that basis explicitly; do not infer volume weighting from an alias alone.
rationale: The numerical percentile is meaningful only with its distribution weighting and particle-size metric.  References 49.
recommended_value: Particle diameter at the 10th percentile of a specified cumulative particle-size distribution, such that 10% of the declared distribution weighting lies at or below that diameter.
registry_final_value: Particle diameter at the 10th percentile of a specified cumulative particle-size distribution, such that 10% of the declared distribution weighting lies at or below that diameter.
released_value: Particle diameter at the 10th percentile of a specified cumulative particle-size distribution, such that 10% of the declared distribution weighting lies at or below that diameter.

current_value: A property denoting 50th percentile (median) of particle size distribution from DLS (D50).
implementation: For DLS, specify hydrodynamic diameter, intensity/volume/number weighting and inversion or conversion method. The class can remain generic if every value carries that basis explicitly; do not infer volume weighting from an alias alone.
rationale: The numerical percentile is meaningful only with its distribution weighting and particle-size metric.  References 49.
recommended_value: Particle diameter at the 50th percentile of a specified cumulative particle-size distribution, such that 50% of the declared distribution weighting lies at or below that diameter.
registry_final_value: Particle diameter at the 50th percentile of a specified cumulative particle-size distribution, such that 50% of the declared distribution weighting lies at or below that diameter.
released_value: Particle diameter at the 50th percentile of a specified cumulative particle-size distribution, such that 50% of the declared distribution weighting lies at or below that diameter.

current_value: A property denoting 90th percentile of particle size distribution from DLS (D90).
implementation: For DLS, specify hydrodynamic diameter, intensity/volume/number weighting and inversion or conversion method. The class can remain generic if every value carries that basis explicitly; do not infer volume weighting from an alias alone.
rationale: The numerical percentile is meaningful only with its distribution weighting and particle-size metric.  References 49.
recommended_value: Particle diameter at the 90th percentile of a specified cumulative particle-size distribution, such that 90% of the declared distribution weighting lies at or below that diameter.
registry_final_value: Particle diameter at the 90th percentile of a specified cumulative particle-size distribution, such that 90% of the declared distribution weighting lies at or below that diameter.
released_value: Particle diameter at the 90th percentile of a specified cumulative particle-size distribution, such that 90% of the declared distribution weighting lies at or below that diameter.

current_value: A property denoting maximum (peak) power density extracted from polarization curve.
implementation: Record the reference quantity and units for every value. Prefer an area-specific subclass for W cm⁻², a volumetric subclass for W cm⁻³, and a mass-specific subclass for W g⁻¹; do not impose area normalization on existing records without evidence.
rationale: A peak power density requires a declared normalization basis; electrode area, volume and mass are not interchangeable.
recommended_value: Maximum electrical output power per declared electrode-area, system-volume or mass reference, obtained over a specified operating curve under stated conditions.
registry_final_value: Maximum electrical output power per declared electrode-area, system-volume or mass reference, obtained over a specified operating curve under stated conditions.
released_value: Maximum electrical output power per declared electrode-area, system-volume or mass reference, obtained over a specified operating curve under stated conditions.

current_value: A property denoting peroxide yield and determined in Rotating Ring Disk Voltammetry.
implementation: For a disk producing only the two- and four-electron ORR products and a ring that quantitatively oxidizes peroxide, peroxide percent = 200(|I_ring|/N)/(|I_disk| + |I_ring|/N), using corrected currents and collection efficiency N. Record electrolyte, potentials and correction protocol; do not equate this molecular fraction with peroxide Faradaic efficiency.
rationale: Identifies molecular product selectivity rather than electron-based Faradaic efficiency.
recommended_value: The fraction of molecular oxygen consumed in an oxygen-reduction reaction that forms hydrogen peroxide or hydroperoxide, expressed as a fraction or percentage and inferred from rotating ring-disk electrode currents using the calibrated ring collection efficiency.
registry_final_value: The fraction of molecular oxygen consumed in an oxygen-reduction reaction that forms hydrogen peroxide or hydroperoxide, expressed as a fraction or percentage and inferred from rotating ring-disk electrode currents using the calibrated ring collection efficiency.
released_value: The fraction of molecular oxygen consumed in an oxygen-reduction reaction that forms hydrogen peroxide or hydroperoxide, expressed as a fraction or percentage and inferred from rotating ring-disk electrode currents using the calibrated ring collection efficiency.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents pgm on support weight percent for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Adopt only after confirming the source reports metal weight percent of the supported catalyst. If it reports metal/support mass ratio, use the alternative and rename accordingly.
rationale: Conventional supported-catalyst weight percent requires the total-catalyst denominator.
recommended_value: The mass of platinum-group metals in a supported catalyst divided by the total dry mass of those metals and their support, multiplied by 100.
registry_final_value: A composition characteristic that represents pgm on support weight percent for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A composition characteristic that represents pgm on support weight percent for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents phosphoric acid loading for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Label as phosphoric-acid areal loading; record whether the acid mass is calculated as neat H3PO4 or includes water in the acid solution.
rationale: The supplied context explicitly identifies areal loading, which differs from a molar acid-doping ratio.
recommended_value: The mass of phosphoric acid added to a cathode catalyst layer divided by the geometric electrode area to which the acid is applied.
registry_final_value: The mass of phosphoric acid added to a cathode catalyst layer divided by the geometric electrode area to which the acid is applied.
released_value: The mass of phosphoric acid added to a cathode catalyst layer divided by the geometric electrode area to which the acid is applied.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents piston displacement a 1 for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Record displacement sign convention and whether the value is a stroke magnitude or a signed coordinate difference.
rationale: Identifies the source-described extrusion stroke rather than an unspecified displacement.
recommended_value: The downward displacement of the dispensing piston during the extrusion stroke used to deliver ink for one printed pillar.
registry_final_value: The downward displacement of the dispensing piston during the extrusion stroke used to deliver ink for one printed pillar.
released_value: The downward displacement of the dispensing piston during the extrusion stroke used to deliver ink for one printed pillar.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents piston displacement a 2 for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Record displacement sign convention and whether the value is a stroke magnitude or a signed coordinate difference.
rationale: Identifies the source-described retraction stroke rather than an unspecified displacement.
recommended_value: The upward retraction displacement of the dispensing piston applied after pillar stretching to halt ink delivery.
registry_final_value: The upward retraction displacement of the dispensing piston applied after pillar stretching to halt ink delivery.
released_value: The upward retraction displacement of the dispensing piston applied after pillar stretching to halt ink delivery.

current_value: Degree of molecular alignment induced in the adjacent ionomer film by the platinum surface.
implementation: Retrieve the source equation: identify which ionomer vector/group is oriented, the direction relative to the Pt surface, and whether the value is an orientational order parameter, angular statistic, aligned fraction or fitted coefficient. These alternatives cannot share one numerical definition.
rationale: The record does not identify the orientation observable or normalization represented by degree.
registry_final_value: Degree of molecular alignment induced in the adjacent ionomer film by the platinum surface.
released_value: Degree of molecular alignment induced in the adjacent ionomer film by the platinum surface.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents polydispersity index for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Use preferred label DLS polydispersity index. Remove Mw/Mn as an alias; if needed, create a separate molar-mass dispersity class defined as mass-average molar mass divided by number-average molar mass.
rationale: The description establishes DLS cumulant polydispersity; it is different from polymer molar-mass dispersity.  References 25.
recommended_value: A dimensionless measure of the breadth of the distribution of decay rates obtained by cumulant analysis of a dynamic-light-scattering correlation function, equal to the second cumulant divided by the square of the mean decay rate.
registry_final_value: DLSPolydispersityIndex | MolarMassDispersity
released_value: A dimensionless measure of the breadth of the distribution of decay rates obtained by cumulant analysis of a dynamic-light-scattering correlation function, equal to the second cumulant divided by the square of the mean decay rate.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents polymer force exponential coefficient for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Retrieve the DEM polymer-force law containing k2^(polymer), including the separation variable, sign convention, and units. Do not assume it is a decay constant or insert a guessed exponential equation.
rationale: The source-specific symbol does not establish the exponential force equation or the mathematical role of the coefficient.
registry_final_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents polymer force exponential coefficient for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents polymer force exponential coefficient for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents polymer force proportionality constant for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Retrieve the DEM polymer-force equation containing k1^(polymer), identify the multiplied term and interacting entities, and derive the coefficient units from that equation.
rationale: The proportionality constant cannot be uniquely identified without the force law it multiplies.
registry_final_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents polymer force proportionality constant for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A quantitative characteristic that represents polymer force proportionality constant for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A geometric characteristic that represents polymer interaction distance for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Retrieve the force or energy equation containing L^(polymer) and identify exactly which geometric distance it represents. Specify whether it is an input range parameter or a measured separation.
rationale: A length scale in an interaction model could denote center separation, surface gap, range, cutoff or decay length.
registry_final_value: A geometric characteristic that represents polymer interaction distance for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
released_value: A geometric characteristic that represents polymer interaction distance for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.

current_value: A property denoting acid dissociation constant (pKa) of polymer functional group (dimensionless).
implementation: Record apparent versus thermodynamic pKa where relevant to a polyelectrolyte; do not equate measurements at different ionic strengths or protonation states without qualification.
rationale: pKa is -log10(Ka), not Ka itself.  References 13.
recommended_value: The negative base-10 logarithm of the acid dissociation constant of a specified ionizable group in a polymer, for a stated medium, temperature and equilibrium convention.
registry_final_value: The negative base-10 logarithm of the acid dissociation constant of a specified ionizable group in a polymer, for a stated medium, temperature and equilibrium convention.
released_value: The negative base-10 logarithm of the acid dissociation constant of a specified ionizable group in a polymer, for a stated medium, temperature and equilibrium convention.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents poss content relative to ionomer for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Specify the POSS chemistry and dry ionomer mass. This percentage can exceed 100 and is not the POSS mass fraction of the entire layer.
rationale: The source context fixes a mass-of-additive to mass-of-ionomer basis.
recommended_value: The mass of polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane additive divided by the mass of ionomer in the specified catalyst-layer formulation, multiplied by 100 when expressed as a percentage.
registry_final_value: The mass of polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane additive divided by the mass of ionomer in the specified catalyst-layer formulation, multiplied by 100 when expressed as a percentage.
released_value: The mass of polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane additive divided by the mass of ionomer in the specified catalyst-layer formulation, multiplied by 100 when expressed as a percentage.

current_value: A property denoting power efficiency for LED device (lm/W).
implementation: Rename the preferred label to LED luminous efficacy and preferably mint a correspondingly named class IRI. If dimensionless power-conversion efficiency is also needed, define a separate class as optical radiant power divided by electrical input power.
rationale: The supplied lm/W observable is device luminous efficacy, rather than a power-conversion efficiency.  References 46.
recommended_value: The luminous flux emitted by an LED device divided by its electrical input power under specified operating conditions.
registry_final_value: LEDLuminousEfficacy
released_value: The luminous flux emitted by an LED device divided by its electrical input power under specified operating conditions.

current_value: A property denoting printability Z number and determined in Ink Printability Assessment.
implementation: Specify whether L is nozzle diameter, nozzle radius or another length. Do not encode a universal printable Z interval; experimental ranges depend on the printing system.
rationale: Identifies the defining physical ratio rather than repeating the metric name.  References 28.
recommended_value: The dimensionless inverse Ohnesorge number, equal to the square root of the product of liquid density, surface tension and stated characteristic jetting length divided by dynamic viscosity, used as an indicator of inkjet-fluid printability.
registry_final_value: The dimensionless inverse Ohnesorge number, equal to the square root of the product of liquid density, surface tension and stated characteristic jetting length divided by dynamic viscosity, used as an indicator of inkjet-fluid printability.
released_value: The dimensionless inverse Ohnesorge number, equal to the square root of the product of liquid density, surface tension and stated characteristic jetting length divided by dynamic viscosity, used as an indicator of inkjet-fluid printability.

current_value: A morphology coefficient used in a parameterized probability-density representation of material structure.
implementation: Supply the complete probability-density equation, the structural random variable and its support, and whether k is a shape, scale, exponent or normalization parameter. No replacement equation can be recovered from the record alone.
rationale: The symbol k is not linked to an identified probability-density function.
registry_final_value: A morphology coefficient used in a parameterized probability-density representation of material structure.
released_value: A morphology coefficient used in a parameterized probability-density representation of material structure.

current_value: A geometric characteristic that represents propylene glycol methyl ether volume fraction for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: State whether the denominator is the sum of separately dispensed solvent volumes or the measured final mixture volume, and whether a value is a fraction or percentage. These conventions differ for non-additive liquid mixtures.
rationale: Identifies a constituent composition ratio and its denominator.
recommended_value: The volume of propylene glycol methyl ether used in the solvent mixture divided by the total solvent-volume basis specified for that mixture.
registry_final_value: The volume of propylene glycol methyl ether used in the solvent mixture divided by the total solvent-volume basis specified for that mixture.
released_value: The volume of propylene glycol methyl ether used in the solvent mixture divided by the total solvent-volume basis specified for that mixture.

current_value: A layer thickness that represents proton conduct layer thickness fraction in mcl for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Identify the designated sublayer X and whether values are fractions or percentages; use the same reference state and spatial averaging convention for both thicknesses.
rationale: Defines the dimensionless geometric fraction described in the contextual record.
recommended_value: The through-plane thickness of the designated proton-conducting sublayer divided by the total through-plane thickness of the cathode multilayer catalyst layer.
registry_final_value: The through-plane thickness of the designated proton-conducting sublayer divided by the total through-plane thickness of the cathode multilayer catalyst layer.
released_value: The through-plane thickness of the designated proton-conducting sublayer divided by the total through-plane thickness of the cathode multilayer catalyst layer.

current_value: A property denoting pseudo double layer capacitance and determined in Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Potentiostatic.
implementation: Retrieve the equivalent circuit and fitted impedance/admittance equation. If the fitted element is a CPE, define Q in Y = Q(j omega)^alpha and keep alpha and any Q-to-effective-capacitance conversion separate. If a capacitance in farads is reported, identify its physical/effective meaning and conversion formula. Do not silently rename Q as capacitance.
rationale: The supplied name does not distinguish a true effective capacitance, a pseudocapacitance, or the magnitude parameter of a constant-phase element.
registry_final_value: A property denoting pseudo double layer capacitance and determined in Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Potentiostatic.
released_value: A property denoting pseudo double layer capacitance and determined in Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Potentiostatic.

current_value: A property denoting pt chemical surface area and determined in Electron Microscopy Imaging.
implementation: Prefer label microscopy-derived Pt physical surface area. Confirm whether the source reports total area or area per Pt mass before adopting: the replacement is for total area; for m2/g_Pt use the alternative. Check overlap with PhysicalSurfaceAreaPtCatalyst before adding a duplicate.
rationale: Microscopy estimates geometric Pt surface rather than directly establishing electrochemical accessibility.
recommended_value: The physical surface area of platinum particles estimated from electron-microscopy measurements of their size, shape or reconstructed morphology.
registry_final_value: A property denoting pt chemical surface area and determined in Electron Microscopy Imaging.
released_value: A property denoting pt chemical surface area and determined in Electron Microscopy Imaging.

current_value: A composition characteristic that represents ptfe loading fraction of solids for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Multiply by 100 for percentage. State which components are counted as dry solids and whether the PTFE is reported as dry polymer rather than dispersion mass.
rationale: The wt.% of solids context identifies a dry-solid mass basis.
recommended_value: The mass of polytetrafluoroethylene divided by the total dry-solid mass of the specified ink or layer formulation.
registry_final_value: The mass of polytetrafluoroethylene divided by the total dry-solid mass of the specified ink or layer formulation.
released_value: The mass of polytetrafluoroethylene divided by the total dry-solid mass of the specified ink or layer formulation.

current_value: An electrochemical characteristic that represents pt hydrogen adsorption specific charge for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
implementation: Record surface/electrolyte conditions, selected adsorption/desorption branch and background subtraction. A conventional calibration value is protocol-dependent; do not hard-code one universal value.
rationale: Identifies the area-normalized calibration quantity, rather than charge per catalyst mass.
recommended_value: The electrical charge associated with adsorption or desorption of hydrogen divided by the platinum surface area to which that charge is assigned, used as a calibration charge density for hydrogen-adsorption-based Pt surface-area determination.
registry_final_value: The electrical charge associated with adsorption or desorption of hydrogen divided by the platinum surface area to which that charge is assigned, used as a calibration charge density for hydrogen-adsorption-based Pt surface-area determination.
released_value: The electrical charge associated with adsorption or desorption of hydrogen divided by the platinum surface area to which that charge is assigned, used as a calibration charge density for hydrogen-adsorption-based Pt surface-area determination.

current_value: A property denoting phenomenon/metric describing reduced ORR activity due to adsorption/poisoning of Pt by ionomer sulfonate groups (review discussion).
implementation: Adopt this qualitative property only if the class denotes the effect. If a measured numeric quantity is intended, define a separate activity-loss ratio or adsorbate coverage with its baseline and test conditions; if the class denotes adsorption as a process, reclassify it in the Process branch instead.
rationale: Separates the scientifically meaningful poisoning effect from an undefined numeric metric.
recommended_value: An inhibited electrocatalytic state of a platinum surface caused by adsorption of ionomer-associated species under the specified reaction and environmental conditions.
registry_final_value: A property denoting phenomenon/metric describing reduced ORR activity due to adsorption/poisoning of Pt by ionomer sulfonate groups (review discussion).
